messages:
mike_support: Hey @sara_security — just got an escalated ticket from Acme: after a scheduled KMS rotation they suddenly lost access to the model endpoint and billing console. Customer says they used the console and then received 403s. Can you triage?
sara_security: Thanks — can you drop the exact errors the customer saw and whether this is Hosted/Dedicated/Private? Also any recent RBAC changes in the last 24h?
mike_support: Customer environment: Hosted API (public). Errors: \`403 Forbidden: missing permission model.infer for resource model:acme-prod/gpt-v2\` and \`403 Forbidden: missing permission billing.view for account acme-prod\`. They pasted an audit log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T14:02:08Z user=svc-acme-console action=KeyAccess key=kms/rot-2026-03 status=SUCCESS
2026-03-17T14:02:12Z user=svc-acme-console action=ModelInvoke resource=model:acme-prod/gpt-v2 status=DENIED reason=missing_permission:rbac.model.invoke
```
They also mentioned a KMS rotation completed ~14:02Z.
sara_security: Hmm — the denied reason references \`rbac.model.invoke\`. We shipped a small RBAC refactor last night that renamed some actions (model.invoke -> model.infer) but we added compatibility mappings. Need to check whether compatibility mapping applied for Hosted customers. @olivia_eng can you check the mapping table and whether it got rolled back in the last deploy?
olivia_eng: On it. Quick check in deploy logs — the mapping service got a hotfix at 13:55Z. The config shows mapping version v2.1 with entries:
```
# rbac-mappings v2.1
model.invoke -> model.infer
billing.read -> billing.view
```
But I see the mapping agent failed to load the file from S3 once (403 on the fetch) at 13:58Z. Could be transient during rotation.
olivia_eng: Also seeing a follow-up: when mapping agent fails, we currently default to strict mode (no fallback). That would explain the denies.
mike_support: Customer confirmed timeline matches our deploy window plus KMS rotation. They also said they couldn't view billing until we fixed permissions.
grant_oncall: I can push a temporary compatibility patch to avoid customer impact. Plan: add a one-off RBAC alias for acme-prod org mapping that treats \`rbac.model.invoke\` as allowed for the model.infer permission and grant billing.read -> billing.view for that org. Applying now.
grant_oncall: Running command:
```
redwoodctl rbac alias create --org acme-prod --from "rbac.model.invoke" --to "model.infer" --ttl 24h
redwoodctl rbac alias create --org acme-prod --from "billing.read" --to "billing.view" --ttl 24h
```
grant_oncall: Patch applied at 14:12Z, waiting for propagation (should be < 30s).
kms-bot: Automated notice: KMS rotation completed. rotation_id=rot-2026-03-17-14-00. Affected keys: kms/acme-prod-default. Rotation initiated by svc-acme-console.
mike_support: Pushed commands to customer to re-auth and try model call and billing console. They responded: "re-auth done — model calls returned 200, billing page loads" :white_check_mark:
sara_security: Good. We need a permanent fix: either make mapping agent tolerant to S3 transient errors or ensure it falls back to the last-known mapping rather than strict deny. Also audit KMS rotation trigger path: rotation should not interfere with mapping fetch permissions.
olivia_eng: Agreed. I'll open an ENG task to change mapping agent fallback behavior and add an integration test simulating S3 403 during startup. Also adding a small healthcheck that prevents startup if mapping load fails but allows previous mapping to remain in memory.
grant_oncall: I'll follow up with a postmortem blameless note for the incident channel. For now ticket updated: access restored, customer satisfied. Recommend adding a short runbook entry to support for KMS-rotation + RBAC mapping checks.
mike_support: Thanks everyone — closing the customer escalation after confirming they accepted workaround. Adding link to ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/ACME-1221
sara_security: Filing a vuln/ops note: this change resulted in an availability impact; low severity but customer-facing. Tagging for next security review and compliance audit. :lock:
grant_oncall: Postmortem draft started: https://docs.redwood.ai/incident/ACME-1221-pm
mike_support: Closing thread. If any follow-ups from the customer, I'll reopen. Cheers.
